page.layout: Running head across top "Locorum Scripturæ." centred. Two parallel columns of a Scripture index table, left column (Cap. | Verf. | Pag.) and right column (Cap. | Verf. | Pag.), separated by a vertical rule. Below the columns, a signature "Oooo 2" centred-left and catchword-like "Cap.XVI." at right.

main_text.l: Cap. | Verf. | Pag. || Cap. | Verf. | Pag.

page.notes: Table of Scripture references with chapter (Cap.), verse (Verf.) and page (Pag.) columns; the chapter numerals are printed only at the first line of each group. The catchword "Cap.XVI." is at the foot of the right column. Some page numbers are uncertain, e.g. "94,431" possibly "94,431" with a doubtful 1; "1091" may be "109:" in print. Verse "1112,1146" and "1212" read as printed.
